mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a word or group of words which express a complete idea as in English with which you are assumed to be familiar or any other language for that matter.
A complete sentence in Arabic grammar is a word or group of words which express a complete idea as in English with which you are assumed to be familiar or any other language for that matter.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a word used with a noun or pronoun to show their relationship with other words in a sentence.
Notes on the Prepositions A preposition in Arabic is a word used with a noun or pronoun to show their relationship with other words in a sentence.
Fill in the blank: ______ are those that contain weak letter in one of its trilaterals.
The weak verbs are those that contain weak letter in one of its trilaterals.
fib: ______ are those whose letters are completely sound, those that have hamzah as one of its trilateral called mahm z and those with doubled letter called muda aff.
The sound verbs are those whose letters are completely sound, those that have hamzah as one of its trilateral called mahm z and those with doubled letter called muda aff.
______ are used for the definite articles, while the double vowels are used for indefinite articles.
Single vowels are used for the definite articles, while the double vowels are used for indefinite articles.
